comment: The default arrangement, whose left column R1 measured with right edges at 380, 370 and 452 and tops at 78, 90 and 80, and whose right column stood at 1631 and 1600. Each shipped layout is loaded through Dockers > Layouts at the size the files were written for, and the dump's windows array holds every rectangle the app opened. Default is loaded last as well as first, so the last shot is the arrangement a fresh profile opens.
